Warm-up: *High Five* high five everyone before you pull
*Compliment* say something kind to the player on your left
*Accent* speak in an accent until your next turn
*Statue* freeze in a pose until someone laughs
*Left Hand* play your next turn with your off hand
*Theme Song* hum a TV theme until someone guesses it
*Swap Seats* trade places with any player
*Mirror* copy the player across from you
*Name Game* name a fruit for each letter of your name
*Toast* raise a glass to the best idea today
*Echo* repeat everyone's last word for a round
*Fan Club* the group cheers loudly for your next pull
Challenge: *Speed Round* pull your next block in under ten seconds
*One Finger* pull this round using a single finger
*Blindfold* pull your next block with your eyes closed
*Balance* stand on one leg while you play
*Rhyme Time* go around rhyming until someone stalls
*Categories* name things from A to Z as a group
*Tongue Twister* say red lorry yellow lorry five times fast
*Hum It* hum a song until someone names it
*Countdown* count to twenty, one voice at a time
*Rock Paper* best of three against the player of your choice
*Staring Contest* first to blink takes the next turn
Story: *Hidden Talent* show off a talent nobody knows about
*Dream Trip* where would you go with a free plane ticket
*Best Meal* describe the best meal you have ever eaten
*First Job* tell us about your very first job
*Superpower* pick one superpower and defend your choice
*Time Machine* past or future, and which year
*Movie Line* quote a movie and let the group guess it
*Proudest Build* what is the best thing you have ever made
*Bucket List* share one thing you will do this year
*Childhood Toy* describe your favorite toy as a kid
*Two Truths* share two truths and a lie, the group guesses
